task: Reconcile the dev_start phase-policy drift so command-policy.ts allowedPhases and config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS agree, making npm run test:process-fact-contract pass without changing dev_start's behavior.
outcome:
The process-fact contract is green and the documented dev_start recovery is actually runnable:
$ npm run test:process-fact-contract
  ... (no 'dev_start INIT/DEV policy/default phase drift')
  exit 0
and a manual recovery call is no longer refused by the phase-tools gate in DEV:
$ lattice dev_start '{"storyId":"B-xxx"}'   # story in DEV with a missing/broken worktree
  (re-bootstraps the worktree; previously refused because DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS omitted dev_start in DEV)
facts: The dev_start HANDLER itself (handlers/worktree.ts:823) enforces allowedPhases = ['INIT','INIT_CHECK','PLAN','DEV'] and throws otherwise; INIT is REQUIRED because the atomic story_advance INIT_CHECK flow runs dev_start while the story is still at INIT (B-804c CHK-001).
core/command-policy.ts:130 also declares dev_start allowedPhases = ['INIT','INIT_CHECK','PLAN','DEV'] (B-804c bootstrap/recovery window, refused in REVIEW/TEST/DONE).
core/config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS lists dev_start only under INIT_CHECK and PLAN — missing INIT and DEV. It is the only one of the three sources with the narrower set.

isCommandAllowed (config.ts:406) IS a runtime enforcement gate (cli-engine.ts filters/refuses top-level commands by phase via it). So omitting dev_start from INIT/DEV in DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS means a MANUAL `lattice dev_start` is refused there, even though the handler + command-policy permit it. Internal co-invocation by story_advance bypasses this gate (config.ts:199 comment).

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs assertCommandPolicyPhaseAlignment requires, for every command x every phase, command-policy.allowedPhases.includes(phase) === isCommandAllowed-from-DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS. dev_start INIT + DEV are the only reported drifts.
The reverse direction is also asserted: every DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS pattern must map to a policy-approved command.
constraints: Do NOT change dev_start's behavior, the worktree bootstrap flow, or any other command's policy/phase set.
Add the exact literal 'dev_start' to the INIT and DEV arrays of DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS (not a wildcard that could widen other commands).
After the change npm run test:process-fact-contract must exit 0 (no remaining drift); lattice validate must stay green.
All artifacts and emitted strings are English-only.
touchpoints: packages/main/src/core/config.ts (DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS: add dev_start under INIT and DEV)
packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts (read-only confirmation of the authoritative set)
scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs (the regression guard — already asserts the invariant)
packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts (read-only: dev_start handler allowedPhases, the third corroborating source)
